decisions.reason: Adding 5V current measurement does not change the standalone USB 3.3V supply behavior, source selection, or powered load.
The source adds metering of the existing 5V rail but does not change its voltage, loads, switching GPIO, or shutdown behavior.
Mentioning SPS30 and ZE08 as heavy 5V consumers does not change the sensor-board connector role or the specified 3.3V I2C sensor interfaces.
Measuring the 5V rail does not alter the AXP2101 battery, USB, VMID/VSYS, or normal-operation power path.
The source identifies LEDs as major 5V consumers but does not change their 5V supply or level-shifter requirement.
The 5V rail metering decision has no effect on the battery connector series, pitch, mounting, or unresolved pinout.
Referring to LEDs as 5V rail consumers does not change the separate board's role, LED count, or LED family.
The source does not change any interboard connector type, pinout, signal, or pin-order rule; a possible second monitor is only an unaccepted implementation idea.
The power-metering change does not affect BOOT or reset controls and their capacitance.
The source does not change the selected ESP32-S3 module or establish any change to its breakout.
Adding 5V rail current monitoring does not change USB enumeration or the USB-C programming interface.
Although LEDs are named as measured 5V loads, the source does not change their cutoff behavior, GPIO control, or standby-current target.
